description: Image Description: The image features a black plastic chair with a minimalist design, resembling a child's chair or a modernist piece of furniture. The chair has four legs, and each leg is fitted with a bright yellow rubber boot, giving the impression that the chair is "wearing" boots. The boots are classic rainboot style, with a rounded toe and a slight heel, and they appear to be securely attached to the chair legs. On the backrest of the chair, there is a clock
